implementation.semantics: Declared public files become UTF-8 data URLs for native staticFile/getStaticFiles; raw UTF-8 bytes, newlines and sizeInBytes are retained. JSON module imports remain parsed objects, not URL strings.
implementation.validation: Strict UTF-8, existing Rust source/path/resource budgets, declared source snapshot and archive digests remain authoritative. Unsupported public binaries remain rejected.
implementation.network: Unchanged opaque-origin capture CSP permits data URLs, not external network fetches or nested frames.
implementation.revision: Known archived text inputs can be revised; no implicit source-file creation, undeclared filesystem reads or author Node execution.
implementation.provenance: Existing adapter SHA automatically includes compiler source changes; incompatible historical adapter locks still require explicit recompilation rather than silent reinterpretation. The shared compiler hash also belongs to the Three adapter.

withExistingRevisionAdmission.skippedReason: Existing real HyperFrames/Remotion revision tests require their separate environment flag; not counted as executed.

explicitRecommendedEslint.scope: CLI and fixture paths are outside canonical frontend ESLint globs; checked explicitly without changing repository lint configuration.

cases: declared getStaticFiles inventory and UTF-8 byte sizes
JSON source import remains an object
author directory moved before archive rebuild
archived JSON revision changes exact rendered colors
negativeControls: external network fetch rejected by unchanged capture policy
browser.independentDecoder: FFmpeg decodes every 32x32 RGBA channel; expected solid calibration colors are independent of production pixels

reproduction.startupCorrection: The first browser runner imported the Node/Vite bundler facade under Bun and failed before any capture. It now imports only workspace Playwright, matching existing native probe hosts. No dependency was changed.

limits: Data files are made available; this does not implement all third-party caption/Lottie parsers or their ecosystem dependencies.
No new standalone encoded-video, installed Electron, cross-machine or full-MV acceptance is claimed.
Original resource/output budgets and unsupported binary-extension policy are unchanged.
